關鍵差別

segments.en: Both attacks work the same way: user text gets mixed into code (SQL or HTML) and the computer can't tell where your text ends and the code starts. The fix also works the same way: keep the data separate from the code. Use parameters for SQL, and escape output for HTML.
segments.zh: 兩種攻擊的原理相同：使用者的文字被混進程式碼（SQL 或 HTML），電腦分不出你的文字在哪裡結束、程式碼從哪裡開始。修法的原理也相同：讓資料和程式碼分開。SQL 用參數，HTML 用輸出跳脫（escape）。

攻擊資料庫

segments.en: Input glued into a query string changes the query itself: skip the password check, read other users' data, delete tables. Fix: parameterized queries.
segments.zh: 被拼進查詢字串的輸入會改變查詢本身：跳過密碼檢查、讀取別人的資料、刪除資料表。修法：參數化查詢。
攻擊你的使用者

segments.en: Input inserted into a page as HTML becomes a script that runs in every visitor's browser, as them. Fix: insert text, not HTML (escape output), plus a CSP.
segments.zh: 以 HTML 插入頁面的輸入會變成腳本，在每位訪客的瀏覽器裡以他們的身分執行。修法：插入文字而不是 HTML（輸出跳脫），再加上 CSP。
原則
資料 ≠ 程式碼

segments.en: Never build code by gluing user text into it. Let the database driver or the browser keep the two apart.
segments.zh: 永遠不要把使用者的文字拼進程式碼。交給資料庫驅動程式或瀏覽器把兩者分開。
取捨

segments.en: The fixes cost almost nothing, and modern frameworks do them by default. The risk lives in the escape hatches: raw SQL helpers, innerHTML, dangerouslySetInnerHTML, |safe. Review every one.
segments.zh: 這些修法幾乎沒有成本，現代框架也預設就會做。風險藏在那些逃生口：原生 SQL 輔助函式、innerHTML、dangerouslySetInnerHTML、|safe。每一個都要審查。

'字串拼接'

segments.en: 'The database gets one long string and has no way to know which part came from the user. A quote in the input ends the string early, and whatever follows is read as SQL.'
segments.zh: '資料庫收到一長串字串，無從得知哪一部分來自使用者。輸入裡的單引號會提早結束字串，後面的內容全被當成 SQL 讀取。'
'參數'

segments.en: 'The query is sent with placeholders. The values are sent separately and are always treated as data, so quotes and dashes in them can\'t change the query. Every database driver and ORM supports this.'
segments.zh: '查詢是帶著佔位符送出的，值則另外傳送，而且永遠被當成資料，所以裡面的引號和破折號改變不了查詢。每個資料庫驅動程式和 ORM 都支援。'
'密碼'

segments.en: 'The sandbox compares plain passwords to keep things simple. Real apps store a slow hash (bcrypt, argon2) and compare hashes, so a leaked table doesn\'t leak passwords.'
segments.zh: '為了簡單，沙盒直接比對明文密碼。真實的 App 會儲存慢速雜湊（bcrypt、argon2）並比對雜湊值，這樣資料表外洩也不會洩漏密碼。'

segments.en: 'Tells the browser “parse this as HTML”. Tags become elements, and event handlers like onerror become running code. React\'s dangerouslySetInnerHTML does the same.'
segments.zh: '告訴瀏覽器「把這段當成 HTML 解析」。標籤會變成元素，像 onerror 這樣的事件處理器會變成會執行的程式碼。React 的 dangerouslySetInnerHTML 也一樣。'

segments.en: 'Tells the browser “this is text”. < shows up as a character. Frameworks like React, Vue and Svelte do this by default when you write {review.text}.'
segments.zh: '告訴瀏覽器「這是文字」。< 會顯示成一個字元。React、Vue、Svelte 等框架在你寫 {review.text} 時預設就會這樣做。'
'內容安全政策（CSP）'

segments.en: 'A second layer of defense: the browser refuses to run inline scripts and scripts from other sites. It catches the bugs you miss. It doesn\'t replace escaping.'
segments.zh: '第二道防線：瀏覽器拒絕執行行內腳本和其他網站的腳本。它能攔下你漏掉的漏洞，但不能取代跳脫。'

segments.en: 'Ben suggests blocking SQL injection by deleting quote characters from every input. What\'s the problem?'
segments.zh: 'Ben 建議把每個輸入裡的單引號都刪掉，藉此擋下 SQL 注入。問題在哪裡？'
'沒問題。沒有單引號就不可能注入'

segments.en: 'Attackers have many tricks that don\'t need a quote (numeric fields, encodings, other syntax). And O\'Brien can no longer sign up.'
segments.zh: '攻擊者有很多不需要單引號的手法（數字欄位、編碼、其他語法）。而且 O\'Brien 從此無法註冊。'

segments.en: 'It breaks real input and can be bypassed. Parameterized queries fix the cause.'
segments.zh: '它會弄壞正常輸入，也能被繞過。參數化查詢才是根本解法。'

segments.en: 'Filtering input guesses which characters are dangerous. Parameters remove the possibility of input becoming SQL at all.'
segments.zh: '過濾輸入是在猜哪些字元危險。參數則讓輸入完全不可能變成 SQL。'

segments.en: 'It works, but it slows the database down'
segments.zh: '有用，但會拖慢資料庫'

segments.en: 'Speed isn\'t the issue. It\'s an incomplete defense that also rejects valid data.'
segments.zh: '問題不在速度。它是不完整的防禦，還會擋掉合法資料。'

segments.en: 'An attacker posts a review that runs a script. Whose data is at risk?'
segments.zh: '攻擊者發了一則會執行腳本的評論。誰的資料有危險？'

segments.en: 'Only the attacker\'s, since it\'s their review'
segments.zh: '只有攻擊者自己的，因為那是他的評論'

segments.en: 'The script runs in the browser of whoever views the page, not the person who wrote it.'
segments.zh: '腳本是在瀏覽這個頁面的人的瀏覽器中執行，不是在作者的。'

segments.en: 'Every fan who opens the page: the script can act as them and read what they see'
segments.zh: '每位打開這個頁面的歌迷：腳本可以冒用他們的身分，讀取他們看到的內容'

segments.en: 'That\'s what makes stored XSS serious. One post, many victims.'
segments.zh: '這就是儲存型 XSS 嚴重的地方：一則貼文，大量受害者。'
'只有資料庫的'

segments.en: 'XSS runs in browsers, not on the server. It targets your users.'
segments.zh: 'XSS 是在瀏覽器裡執行，不是在伺服器上。它攻擊的是你的使用者。'

segments.en: 'Cai wants reviews to support bold and links, so they plan to switch to dangerouslySetInnerHTML. What\'s the safe way to do it?'
segments.zh: 'Cai 想讓評論支援粗體和連結，打算改用 dangerouslySetInnerHTML。安全的做法是什麼？'

segments.en: 'Just do it. React will escape it anyway.'
segments.zh: '直接用。React 反正會跳脫。'

segments.en: 'The name is a warning: React skips escaping for exactly this prop.'
segments.zh: '這個名字本身就是警告：React 正是對這個屬性跳過跳脫。'

segments.en: 'Use a limited format (like Markdown) or an HTML sanitizer with a strict allowlist, plus a CSP'
segments.zh: '使用受限的格式（例如 Markdown），或搭配嚴格白名單的 HTML 清理器，再加上 CSP'

segments.en: 'Allow only the few tags you need, strip everything else (scripts, event handlers), and keep CSP as a backup.'
segments.zh: '只允許你需要的少數標籤，其他全部移除（腳本、事件處理器），並保留 CSP 作為後備。'

segments.en: 'Check whether the text contains “<script>” and reject it'
segments.zh: '檢查文字是否包含「<script>」，有的話就拒絕'

segments.en: 'Scripts can run without a script tag (like the onerror example). Blocklists always miss something.'
segments.zh: '腳本不需要 script 標籤也能執行（像 onerror 那個例子）。黑名單永遠會漏掉東西。'
